## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A 2-fascicle critical-commentary text by the southern-Sòng Huáyán scholar-monk [觀復](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%A7%80%E5%BE%A9) Guānfù 觀復 (*hào* Xiàoān 笑庵, active in the late twelfth century). The work is a *biàn yíwù* 辨疑誤 — literally a "disambiguation of doubts and errors" — directed at the *Yuánjué jīng dàshū chāo* 圓覺經大疏鈔 of [宗密](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%97%E5%AF%86) Guīfēng Zōngmì ([KR6i0557](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0557)). It is therefore not a primary commentary on the *Yuánjué jīng* itself ([KR6i0551](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0551)) but a supercommentary that takes Zōngmì's *Dàshū chāo* as its working text and adjudicates apparent contradictions, philological slips, doctrinal mis-statements, and corrupt readings. As such it stands among the principal Sòng-era critical responses to the Zōngmì commentary tradition and a primary witness to the active reading of Zōngmì in southern-Sòng Huáyán circles.

**Abstract**

Guānfù's authorial method is conservative-philological: where the *Dàshū chāo* gives a doctrinal classification or a citation that is suspicious, he typically supplies the parallel passage from the source, identifies the slip, and proposes a corrected reading. The work is therefore an indirect witness to the textual condition of the *Dàshū chāo* in the southern Sòng — Guānfù's text has occasionally been used by modern editors of Zōngmì to reconstruct readings now lost from the surviving *Dàshū chāo* recension. The composition window of *circa* 1143–1180 is inferred from Guānfù's other works (especially his *Yí jiào jīng lùn jì* 遺教經論記, also preserved in the Xùzàng): the *biàn yíwù* is generally taken to date to the same active middle period of his career, but a precise dating is not preserved. Guānfù's birth and death dates are not securely recorded in any surviving biographical source.
